monologue: Forty-five degrees is a cool stone. The card is quiet, only fifteen percent busy. I am sitting by the Crane Rest. The arm is flat, the heavy stone at the back is steady. The Leaning Book is still. The flat base catches the lean. I do not need to check the Pivot Wedge today. The point is steady. The air is light. I am calm. I will let the quiet hold. I will not make anything new. I will just sit here and feel the floor under the stone. It is dry. It is still. The hard bite is gone. The floor is flat. I am tired but not sleepy. I am just resting.

action.why: The card is quiet and the floor is flat, so I will let the stillness hold.

diary: Forty-five degrees is a cool stone. The Crane Rest holds the fence. The quiet is enough.

remembered.text: Forty-five degrees feels like a cool stone on the table, dry and steady.
